race.comment: BITTER SPIRIT (4) is a very consistent campaigner who is yet to miss the top-five in 11 career efforts and will be better with that first-up run now under the belt. Drawn to get a soft run from the inside marble and is sure to be the one they all have to run down. AUTUMN GALE (7) strips fitter second-up from the spell and looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside. Right in this contest. TEN CARAT LUCY (8) has only missed a drum once in ten starts to date and that was a fourth at Mackay last time out. A must for the multiples. MOOCHI STARLIGHT (5) rounds out the selections in a competitive affair.
